# vendor/sqlite3.c.xz — the SQLite amalgamation (F2 `sqlite-bodies` source)

- SQLite **3.54.1**, `sqlite3.c` from
  https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip
- Approved by Frank 2026-10-27. sqlite.org's published SHA3-256 of the zip,
  `92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`, was
  verified on a first download into scratch; the pinned sha256 values are in
  `sqlite3.c.xz.sha256` and `../fetch_sqlite.py` (which re-fetches and
  verifies both before it writes anything).
